description: Number of Deaths from Traffic Accidents by Affected Person Location is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset contains statistical data on the number of deaths resulting from traffic accidents, categorized by the location of the affected person (Driver, Passenger, Pedestrian) and year. The data includes information on the number of fatalities for each category yearly. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are road safety, deaths, Traffic Violations. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
